title: Vitamin D Deficiency
subtitle: What vitamin d deficiency is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports vitamin D’s role in bone health and deficiency causes skeletal diseases. Moderate to emerging evidence exists for extraskeletal roles. Diagnostic methods and supplementation guidelines are based on clinical practice guidelines, though some recommendations vary by region and population.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
